# get_cd

```{r function-get_cd}
#' Download ChromeDriver
#'
#' @param dest_dir Directory containing the WebDriver binaries.
#' @return Invisibly NULL. Downloads or reuses a compatible ChromeDriver.
#' @export
get_cd <- function(dest_dir) {
  require_windows()
  ensure_chromedriver(prepare_directory(dest_dir))
  invisible(NULL)
}

chrome_installation <- function() {
  registry_path <- "Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\App Paths\\chrome.exe"
  app_paths <- unlist(lapply(c("HCU", "HLM"), function(hive) {
    unlist(lapply(c("default", "64-bit", "32-bit"), function(view) {
      tryCatch(suppressWarnings(unlist(utils::readRegistry(registry_path, hive, view = view))),
               error = function(error) NULL)
    }), use.names = FALSE)
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  roots <- Sys.getenv(c("LOCALAPPDATA", "ProgramW6432", "ProgramFiles", "ProgramFiles(x86)"))
  candidates <- c(app_paths, file.path(roots[nzchar(roots)], "Google", "Chrome", "Application", "chrome.exe"))
  candidates <- candidates[grepl("chrome\\.exe$", candidates, ignore.case = TRUE) & file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(candidates)) stop("Google Chrome was not found for this Windows account.", call. = FALSE)

  chrome <- normalizePath(candidates[[1L]], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  version <- run_tool("powershell.exe", c(
    "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command",
    "(Get-Item -LiteralPath $env:WDAUTO_CHROME_EXE).VersionInfo.ProductVersion"
  ), env = c("current", WDAUTO_CHROME_EXE = chrome))
  version <- trimws(version)
  if (!is_chrome_version(version)) stop("Could not determine the installed Chrome version: ", chrome, call. = FALSE)

  architecture <- Sys.getenv("PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432")
  if (!nzchar(architecture)) architecture <- Sys.getenv("PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE")
  platform <- switch(toupper(architecture), AMD64 = "win64", X86 = "win32",
                     stop("Unsupported Windows architecture for ChromeDriver: ", architecture, call. = FALSE))
  list(version = version, platform = platform)
}

is_chrome_version <- function(version) {
  length(version) == 1L && !is.na(version) && grepl("^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+){3}$", version)
}

chrome_build <- function(version) sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", version)

build_release <- function(version, platform, builds, milestones = function() list()) {
  build <- chrome_build(version)
  milestone <- sub("\\..*$", "", version)
  release <- builds[[build]]
  if (is.null(release)) release <- milestones()[[milestone]]
  if (is.null(release) || !is_chrome_version(release$version) ||
      !startsWith(release$version, paste0(milestone, "."))) {
    stop("No matching ChromeDriver release for Chrome ", version, ".", call. = FALSE)
  }
  for (asset in release$downloads$chromedriver) {
    if (identical(asset$platform, platform)) return(list(version = release$version, url = asset$url))
  }
  stop("No ChromeDriver for ", platform, " in release ", release$version, ".", call. = FALSE)
}

driver_request <- function(url) {
  httr2::request(url) |>
    httr2::req_timeout(60) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    httr2::req_perform()
}

response_json <- function(response) {
  jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), simplifyVector = FALSE)
}

find_chromedriver <- function(chrome) {
  milestone <- as.integer(sub("\\..*$", "", chrome$version))
  if (milestone <= 114L) {
    root <- "https://chromedriver.storage.googleapis.com"
    response <- driver_request(paste0(root, "/LATEST_RELEASE_", chrome_build(chrome$version)))
    version <- trimws(httr2::resp_body_string(response))
    if (!is_chrome_version(version) || chrome_build(version) != chrome_build(chrome$version)) {
      stop("The legacy server returned an incompatible ChromeDriver version.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    # The legacy Windows archive is named win32 and supports 64-bit Chrome.
    return(list(version = version, url = paste0(root, "/", version, "/chromedriver_win32.zip")))
  }

  root <- "https://googlechromelabs.github.io/chrome-for-testing"
  builds <- response_json(driver_request(paste0(root, "/latest-patch-versions-per-build-with-downloads.json")))
  build_release(chrome$version, chrome$platform, builds$builds, function() {
    response_json(driver_request(paste0(root, "/latest-versions-per-milestone-with-downloads.json")))$milestones
  })
}

installed_driver_version <- function(path) {
  output <- tryCatch(run_tool(path, "--version"), error = function(error) "")
  found <- regmatches(output, regexpr("(?<=ChromeDriver )[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+){3}", output, perl = TRUE))
  if (is_chrome_version(found)) found else NA_character_
}

find_cached_driver <- function(root, chrome) {
  if (!dir.exists(root)) return(NULL)
  files <- list.files(root, "^chromedriver\\.exe$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  candidates <- files[basename(dirname(files)) %in% c(chrome$platform, sub("\\..*$", "", chrome$version))]
  versions <- vapply(candidates, installed_driver_version, character(1))
  matches <- which(!is.na(versions) & chrome_build(versions) == chrome_build(chrome$version))
  if (!length(matches)) return(NULL)
  candidates[matches[order(numeric_version(versions[matches]), decreasing = TRUE)[1L]]]
}

ensure_chromedriver <- function(dest_dir) {
  chrome <- chrome_installation()
  root <- file.path(dest_dir, "chromedriver")
  cached <- find_cached_driver(root, chrome)
  if (!is.null(cached)) return(cached)

  release <- find_chromedriver(chrome)
  target_dir <- prepare_directory(file.path(root, release$version, chrome$platform))
  target <- file.path(target_dir, "chromedriver.exe")
  lock <- directory_lock(file.path(target_dir, ".download.lock"))
  on.exit(filelock::unlock(lock))
  if (file.exists(target) && identical(installed_driver_version(target), release$version)) return(target)

  stage <- prepare_directory(tempfile(".driver-", tmpdir = target_dir))
  on.exit(unlink(stage, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  zip <- file.path(stage, "driver.zip")
  httr2::request(release$url) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    httr2::req_timeout(120) |>
    httr2::req_perform(path = zip)
  entries <- utils::unzip(zip, list = TRUE)$Name
  executable <- grep("(^|/)chromedriver\\.exe$", entries, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(executable) != 1L) stop("ChromeDriver archive does not contain exactly one driver.", call. = FALSE)
  extracted <- utils::unzip(zip, files = executable, exdir = stage, junkpaths = TRUE)
  if (length(extracted) != 1L || !file.exists(extracted) ||
      !identical(installed_driver_version(extracted), release$version)) {
    stop("Downloaded ChromeDriver failed version verification.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!file.rename(extracted, target)) stop("Could not install ChromeDriver at ", target, ".", call. = FALSE)
  target
}
```

```{r example-get_cd, eval=FALSE}
get_cd(dest_dir = "C:/pptsdd-webdriver")
```

# get_ss

```{r function-get_ss}
#' Download Selenium Server
#'
#' @param dest_dir Directory containing the WebDriver binaries.
#' @return Invisibly NULL. Downloads or reuses the supported standalone JAR.
#' @export
get_ss <- function(dest_dir) {
  version <- "3.141.59"
  filename <- paste0("selenium-server-standalone-", version, ".jar")
  root <- file.path(prepare_directory(dest_dir), "selenium")
  if (valid_selenium_jar(file.path(root, "3.141", filename))) return(invisible(NULL))
  directory <- prepare_directory(file.path(root, version))
  jar <- file.path(directory, filename)
  lock <- directory_lock(file.path(directory, ".download.lock"))
  on.exit(filelock::unlock(lock))
  if (valid_selenium_jar(jar)) return(invisible(NULL))

  stage <- tempfile(".selenium-", tmpdir = directory, fileext = ".jar")
  on.exit(unlink(stage), add = TRUE)
  httr2::request(paste0("https://selenium-release.storage.googleapis.com/3.141/", filename)) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    httr2::req_timeout(120) |>
    httr2::req_perform(path = stage)
  if (!valid_selenium_jar(stage)) stop("Downloaded Selenium JAR is invalid.", call. = FALSE)
  if (!file.rename(stage, jar)) stop("Cannot install the Selenium JAR: ", jar, call. = FALSE)
  invisible(NULL)
}

valid_selenium_jar <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(FALSE)
  tryCatch({
    entries <- utils::unzip(path, list = TRUE)$Name
    "META-INF/MANIFEST.MF" %in% entries && any(grepl("GridLauncher(V3)?\\.class$", entries))
  }, warning = function(warning) FALSE, error = function(error) FALSE)
}
```

```{r example-get_ss, eval=FALSE}
get_ss(dest_dir = "C:/pptsdd-webdriver")
```

# auto_cs

```{r function-auto_cs}
#' Start the Selenium WebDriver service
#'
#' @param dest_dir Directory containing the WebDriver binaries.
#' @param autostart Whether to install or update the Windows login startup entry.
#'   Use FALSE to start the service without writing a startup entry.
#' @return Invisibly NULL once the service is ready.
#' @export
auto_cs <- function(dest_dir, autostart = TRUE) {
  require_windows()
  dest_dir <- prepare_directory(dest_dir)
  stopifnot(is.logical(autostart), length(autostart) == 1L, !is.na(autostart))
  state_dir <- service_directory()
  lock <- directory_lock(file.path(state_dir, "service.lock"))
  on.exit(filelock::unlock(lock), add = TRUE)

  driver <- ensure_chromedriver(dest_dir)
  jar <- installed_selenium_jar(dest_dir)
  state_file <- file.path(state_dir, "service.rds")
  state <- read_service_state(state_file)
  handle <- owned_process(state)
  if (!is.null(handle)) {
    if (!identical(state$driver, driver) || !identical(state$jar, jar)) {
      stop("WebDriver is still running with different binaries. Finish active downloads, run reset_cs(), then start again.",
           call. = FALSE)
    }
    if (!with_wait(function() service_ready(state$pid))) {
      stop("Managed WebDriver is running but not ready. Logs: ", state$log_dir, call. = FALSE)
    }
  } else {
    if (length(listener_pids())) {
      stop("Port 4444 is in use by a service not managed by this wdauto installation.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    java <- unname(Sys.which("java"))
    if (!nzchar(java)) stop("Java was not found on PATH.", call. = FALSE)
    run_tool(java, "-version")
    launch_selenium(java, jar, driver, state_dir, state_file)
  }
  if (autostart) configure_startup(state_dir, dest_dir)
  invisible(NULL)
}

require_windows <- function() {
  if (.Platform$OS.type != "windows") stop("wdauto WebDriver management requires Windows.", call. = FALSE)
}

prepare_directory <- function(path) {
  if (!is.character(path) || length(path) != 1L || is.na(path) || !nzchar(trimws(path))) {
    stop("Directory must be a non-empty path.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  path <- path.expand(path)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) stop("Cannot create directory: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

service_directory <- function() {
  root <- Sys.getenv("LOCALAPPDATA")
  if (!nzchar(root)) stop("LOCALAPPDATA is not set for this Windows account.", call. = FALSE)
  prepare_directory(file.path(root, "wdauto"))
}

directory_lock <- function(path) {
  lock <- filelock::lock(path, timeout = 60000)
  if (is.null(lock)) stop("Timed out waiting for wdauto operation: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  lock
}

run_tool <- function(command, args, env = NULL) {
  result <- processx::run(command, args, env = env, timeout = 10000,
                          error_on_status = FALSE, windows_hide_window = TRUE)
  if (result$status != 0L || result$timeout) {
    stop(basename(command), " failed: ", trimws(result$stderr), call. = FALSE)
  }
  result$stdout
}

installed_selenium_jar <- function(dest_dir) {
  prefix <- "^selenium-server-standalone-([23]\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)\\.jar$"
  jars <- list.files(file.path(dest_dir, "selenium"), prefix, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  if (length(jars)) {
    versions <- numeric_version(sub(prefix, "\\1", basename(jars)))
    for (jar in jars[order(versions, decreasing = TRUE)]) {
      if (valid_selenium_jar(jar)) return(jar)
    }
  }
  stop("No valid standalone Selenium JAR found. Check the Selenium cache and run get_ss(dest_dir).", call. = FALSE)
}

read_service_state <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  state <- readRDS(path)
  if (!is.list(state) || !all(c("pid", "time", "marker", "java", "driver", "jar", "log_dir") %in% names(state))) {
    stop("Invalid wdauto process record: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }
  state
}

owned_process <- function(state) {
  if (is.null(state)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch({
    handle <- ps::ps_handle(state$pid, time = state$time)
    if (!ps::ps_is_running(handle)) return(NULL)
    args <- ps::ps_cmdline(handle)
    executable <- normalizePath(ps::ps_exe(handle), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    if (!identical(tolower(executable), tolower(state$java)) ||
        !all(c(state$marker, state$jar, paste0("-Dwebdriver.chrome.driver=", state$driver)) %in% args)) {
      stop("The process at the recorded PID could not be verified as owned by wdauto.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    handle
  }, no_such_process = function(error) NULL)
}

listener_pids <- function() {
  rows <- strsplit(trimws(run_tool("netstat.exe", "-ano")), "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  fields <- strsplit(trimws(rows), "[[:space:]]+")
  matching <- Filter(function(row) {
    length(row) == 5L && row[1L] == "TCP" && endsWith(row[2L], ":4444") &&
      row[3L] %in% c("0.0.0.0:0", "[::]:0")
  }, fields)
  unique(vapply(matching, function(row) as.integer(row[5L]), integer(1)))
}

service_ready <- function(pid) {
  response <- tryCatch({
    httr2::request("http://127.0.0.1:4444/wd/hub/status") |>
      httr2::req_options(noproxy = "127.0.0.1") |>
      httr2::req_timeout(1) |>
      httr2::req_perform() |>
      response_json()
  }, error = function(error) NULL)
  if (!is.list(response)) return(FALSE)
  ready <- if (is.list(response$value)) response$value$ready else NULL
  if (is.null(ready)) ready <- identical(response$status, 0L) || identical(response$status, 0)
  isTRUE(ready) && pid %in% listener_pids()
}

with_wait <- function(ready, seconds = 30) {
  start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  repeat {
    if (ready()) return(TRUE)
    if (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - start >= seconds) return(FALSE)
    Sys.sleep(0.25)
  }
}

launch_selenium <- function(java, jar, driver, state_dir, state_file) {
  log_dir <- prepare_directory(tempfile("selenium-", tmpdir = state_dir))
  marker <- paste0("-Dwdauto.instance=", basename(log_dir))
  java <- normalizePath(java, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  process <- processx::process$new(java, c(marker, paste0("-Dwebdriver.chrome.driver=", driver),
    "-jar", jar, "-host", "127.0.0.1", "-port", "4444"),
    stdout = file.path(log_dir, "stdout.log"), stderr = file.path(log_dir, "stderr.log"),
    cleanup = FALSE, windows_hide_window = TRUE)
  started <- FALSE
  on.exit(if (!started) {
    try(process$kill(), silent = TRUE)
    unlink(state_file)
  }, add = TRUE)

  pid <- process$get_pid()
  time <- tryCatch(ps::ps_create_time(process$as_ps_handle()), error = function(error) {
    stop("Selenium exited or could not be identified. Logs: ", log_dir, call. = FALSE)
  })
  state <- list(pid = pid, time = time, marker = marker, java = java,
                driver = driver, jar = jar, log_dir = log_dir)
  pending <- tempfile(".service-", tmpdir = state_dir)
  on.exit(unlink(pending), add = TRUE)
  saveRDS(state, pending)
  if (!file.rename(pending, state_file)) stop("Cannot save wdauto process state: ", state_file, call. = FALSE)
  ready <- with_wait(function() {
    if (!process$is_alive()) stop("Selenium exited during startup. Logs: ", log_dir, call. = FALSE)
    service_ready(pid)
  })
  if (!ready) stop("Timed out waiting for Selenium on port 4444. Logs: ", log_dir, call. = FALSE)
  started <- TRUE
}

startup_file <- function() {
  appdata <- Sys.getenv("APPDATA")
  if (!nzchar(appdata)) stop("APPDATA is not set for this Windows account.", call. = FALSE)
  file.path(appdata, "Microsoft", "Windows", "Start Menu", "Programs", "Startup", "chrome_driver.bat")
}

owned_startup <- function(file) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(FALSE)
  lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  any(lines == "rem wdauto managed startup") ||
    (any(startsWith(lines, "mshta vbscript:createobject(")) &&
       any(startsWith(lines, "java -Dwebdriver.chrome.driver=") &
             grepl("selenium-server-standalone-", lines, fixed = TRUE)))
}

replace_lines <- function(lines, path) {
  temp <- tempfile(".wdauto-", tmpdir = dirname(path))
  on.exit(unlink(temp))
  writeLines(lines, temp)
  if (!file.rename(temp, path)) stop("Cannot update wdauto file: ", path, call. = FALSE)
}

configure_startup <- function(state_dir, dest_dir) {
  batch <- startup_file()
  if (file.exists(batch) && !owned_startup(batch)) {
    warning("Another startup entry already uses ", batch, ". It was preserved.", call. = FALSE)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  script <- file.path(state_dir, "startup.R")
  rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript.exe")
  lib <- dirname(getNamespaceInfo(asNamespace("wdauto"), "path"))
  replace_lines(c(
    paste0(".libPaths(c(", encodeString(lib, quote = '"'), ", .libPaths()))"),
    paste0("wdauto::auto_cs(", encodeString(dest_dir, quote = '"'), ", autostart = FALSE)")
  ), script)
  quote_batch <- function(path) paste0('"', gsub("%", "%%", path, fixed = TRUE), '"')
  prepare_directory(dirname(batch))
  replace_lines(c(
    "@echo off", "rem wdauto managed startup", "setlocal DisableDelayedExpansion",
    paste(quote_batch(rscript), "--no-save --no-restore", quote_batch(script),
          ">>", quote_batch(file.path(state_dir, "startup.log")), "2>&1")
  ), batch)
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

# reset_cs
    
```{r function-reset_cs}
#' Stop the managed Selenium service and remove its login startup entry
#'
#' @return Invisibly NULL.
#' @export
reset_cs <- function() {
  require_windows()
  state_dir <- service_directory()
  lock <- directory_lock(file.path(state_dir, "service.lock"))
  on.exit(filelock::unlock(lock), add = TRUE)

  state_file <- file.path(state_dir, "service.rds")
  handle <- owned_process(read_service_state(state_file))
  if (!is.null(handle)) {
    children <- tryCatch(ps::ps_children(handle, recursive = TRUE), no_such_process = function(error) list())
    tryCatch(ps::ps_kill(handle), no_such_process = function(error) NULL)
    for (child in children) {
      tryCatch(ps::ps_kill(child), no_such_process = function(error) NULL)
    }
    if (!with_wait(function() !ps::ps_is_running(handle))) {
      stop("Timed out waiting for managed Selenium to stop.", call. = FALSE)
    }
  }
  if (unlink(state_file) != 0L) stop("Cannot remove wdauto process state: ", state_file, call. = FALSE)
  batch <- startup_file()
  if (owned_startup(batch) && unlink(batch) != 0L) {
    stop("Cannot remove the wdauto startup entry: ", batch, call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```
  
```{r example-reset_cs, eval=FALSE}
auto_cs(dest_dir = "C:/pptsdd-webdriver")
reset_cs()
```
